t: This is King's Cross station, a busy passenger terminus on the edge of central London in Camden. It's the southern end of the East Coast Main Line, with trains running north to Yorkshire, the North East and Scotland. Lewis Cubitt, an English civil engineer and architect, designed it. Right next door is St Pancras International, where the Eurostar leaves for the continent, and beneath both stations is the King's Cross St Pancras tube station. Together they form one of the country's largest transport hubs. Cecil Kimber, the driving force behind the M.G. Car Company, died here, as did the Somerset cricketer Percy Hardy.
